blocking_finding.summary: The receipt reports maximum_fft_roundtrip_error = 0, but its diagnostic checks only irfft(stored_frequency) against the time array that was constructed by that same irfft. An independent forward rfft(stored_time) check does not recover the stored frequency array.
blocking_finding.scientific_effect: The package scores time and frequency representations as if they were a coherent dual-domain observation, although many pairs cannot represent the same real signal. Independent noise draws in the two domains also double-count incompatible information. This violates the registered dual-domain-consistency health gate and can change candidate gaps and distinctness classifications.

prediction_forward_roundtrip_failures.mechanism: Complex phase transfer and calibration leave an imaginary Nyquist coefficient. A length-256 real time series cannot represent that coefficient; numpy.irfft discards it while the stored frequency-imag output retains it.

response_forward_roundtrip_failures.mechanism: For every nonzero-noise scenario, time-domain and frequency-domain responses receive separate independent Gaussian draws instead of being two transforms of one synthetic observation.

required_repair_before_pass: Enforce the real-signal Hermitian constraints at both DC and Nyquist after every phase transfer and calibration operation, or construct a valid two-sided spectrum and derive both stored domains from it.

Generate one stochastic observation per detector and derive its other domain by FFT, or use an explicitly registered joint time-frequency covariance without treating duplicate representations as independent evidence.
Replace the one-way inverse check with forward and inverse round-trip checks on every candidate prediction and every synthetic response, including all noise families and the calibration envelope.
Regenerate and rescore the scientific artifacts under a semantics-changing successor version. This cannot be represented as a test-expectation-only correction.
